ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Si alguna vez te apetece observar
el cielo, no tienes más que pulsar
arriba en .
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Quién sabe, quizá descubras un
regalo atado a un globo{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:001C:}}o algún
otro objeto volador{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Nuestro pueblo esconde sorpresas

FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Si toi aussi tu aimes à rêver en
regardant le ciel, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}je te conseille
d'appuyer sur haut sur .

oiseaux ou des nuages,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ou d'un
ballon porteur de cadeau, {{TAG:0007:0000:0C000000}}qui sait ?
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ou peut-être même encore autre
chose de tout à fait inattendu. {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Et je
vais te donner un autre conseil{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} recèle nombre de
surprises, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}alors fais comme moi,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}

{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Se è una bella giornata e vuoi
ammirare il cielo terso, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}premi 
verso l'alto.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Potresti notare qualcosa di insolito,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}

palloncino{{TAG:0003:001C:}} o altri oggetti volanti.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}È solo un consiglio da amica.
{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} è una città splendida:

DE:

einem schönen Tag gerne mal in den
Himmel aufblicken möchtest.
Drücke dazu einfach .{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}Vielleicht

Ungewöhnliches.

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Laufe immer mit offenen Augen
durch {{TAG:0005:0005:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Es ist schließlich

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Did you know you can store items
down at the train station?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001D:}}It's really cool! {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}They have special
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lockers {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}that you can use to hold
souvenirs from other towns.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}If you just put your items in the
locker,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} they'll be shipped right to
your home, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}free of charge!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} you should give it a
try sometime.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}¿Sabes que puedes guardar objetos
en las {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}taquillas {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}de la estación de
tren?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001D:}}¡Son especiales! Podrás acceder a
todo lo que guardes ahí dentro
desde cualquier pueblo.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Es la mejor forma de llevarte
algún recuerdo de tus viajes sin
tener que cargar con él.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Savais-tu que tu pouvais laisser
des objets dans les gares ?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} C'est
extraordinairement pratique !
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Imagine que tu visites une autre ville
et que tu veuilles en ramener un
souvenir{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Mais ton sac est plein et tu ne peux
plus rien porter.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Que faire ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Eh bien,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} tu peux toujours déposer
certaines de tes affaires à la
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}consigne {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}de la gare où tu te trouves.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Cela te libérera de la place et ce
que tu y auras mis sera aussitôt
envoyé à la gare de ta ville.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Penses-y,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} la prochaine fois que tu
voyageras, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Tu verras,
c'est magnifiquement pratique !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Lo sapevi che puoi lasciare
degli oggetti alla stazione?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001D:}}È comodissimo! {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Ci sono degli
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}armadietti {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}in cui, per esempio, puoi
conservare i souvenir di altre città.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Inoltre, gli armadietti della stazione{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
sono collegati alla cassettiera o
all'armadio di casa! Comodo, eh?
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} provali
uno di questi giorni.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Ist dir bewusst, dass du am Bahnhof
Gegenstände lagern kannst?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Das ist überaus praktisch.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Du kannst dort ein {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Schließfach
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}nutzen, um die Souvenirs aus
anderen Städten aufzuheben.
Du legst die Gegenstände einfach in
das {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Schließfach{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}und schon werden
sie direkt in deine Stadt gebracht.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Ohne Mehrkosten!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Du musst es
unbedingt einmal ausprobieren!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Tren istasyonunda eşya saklayabildiğini

koyabileceğin özel {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}dolaplar{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} var.

EN:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}have you ever heard of
feng shui?{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} It's the ancient art of
interior decorating.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}OK, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}that's a simple way to put it,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
but basically it helps you arrange
your home in an optimal way.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}For example,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} yellow objects should
be placed in the west side of your
home.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Green items belong in the southern
part of your home.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} There are some
advantages to doing it this way{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
If you need any more advice,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:001C:}}I would
be happy to stop by for a free
consultation.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Has oído hablar del {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}feng shui{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
cielín? Es un arte ancestral que
se usa en la decoración del hogar.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Te ayuda a colocar los muebles
en el sitio perfecto de tu casa.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Por ejemplo,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} los objetos amarillos
deben colocarse en el lado oeste y
los verdes en el sur.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Seguir las reglas del feng shui tiene
sus ventajas{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:001C:}} Puedo pasarme por
tu casa si quieres más consejos.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}As-tu déjà entendu parler du feng
shui ?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} C'est une façon très ancienne
de penser la décoration d'intérieur.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Pour ne pas t'embêter avec les
détails, {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}cela consiste à arranger les
meubles de manière optimale.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Pour te donner un exemple,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} les
objets jaunes seront idéalement
placés à l'ouest des pièces.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Quant aux objets verts,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} il convient
de les orienter au sud.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Crois-moi, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}on
gagne à respecter ces règles{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Si tu veux en savoir plus sur le feng
shui,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:001C:}}n'hésite pas à me demander
conseil.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Je serai ravie de venir chez toi
pour une consultation gratuite.
IT:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}hai mai sentito parlare
di feng shui?{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} È l'antica arte
di arredare gli interni.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Mmmh... {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Forse non è proprio così
semplice.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Diciamo che è un modo di
progettare gli ambienti in armonia.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Per esempio,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} tutto ciò che è giallo
va nella zona ovest della casa,
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}mentre il verde sta meglio a sud.
È un sistema che comporta notevoli
vantaggi.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Se vuoi saperne di più,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}la prima consulenza è gratis!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Hast du schon einmal von Feng-Shui
gehört, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Im Groben geht
es dabei um gute Raumgestaltung.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}So ist es zum Beispiel vorteilhaft,
gelbe Objekte im Westen deines
Hauses zu platzieren.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Grüne Dinge gehören dagegen in den
Süden.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Das hat greifbare Vorteile!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001C:}}Wenn du weitere Hilfe benötigst,
komme ich gerne zu einer Beratung
bei dir vorbei!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}feng shui’yi hiç duydun
mu?{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Eski bir iç mekân düzenleme sanatı.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Tamam, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}bu biraz fazla basit bir tanım,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
ama özünde evini en uygun biçimde
düzenlemene yardım ediyor.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Mesela,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} sarı eşyalar evin batı tarafına konmalı.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Yeşil eşyaların yeri güney tarafı.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Böyle
yapmanın bazı faydaları var{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
Daha fazla tavsiye istersen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:001C:}}ücretsiz
danışmanlık için uğramaktan
memnun olurum.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}I don't know if you believe in luck,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but I sure do.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}There are certain items I just KNOW
are lucky. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}I have one I carry around
all the time.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}It just so happens my lucky object
goes really well with most of my
outfits. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}What a coincidence!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}So if you find yourself in need of a
lucky break or two, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}think about
picking up a lucky charm.
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}I'd recommend one that matches
your eye color.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}¿Crees en la suerte, cariñín?{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
Yo desde luego, sí.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Hay ciertos objetos que otorgan
suerte a su dueño. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Yo tengo uno
que siempre llevo a todas partes.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}¡Y además combina perfectamente
con todos mis conjuntos! Si eso no
es suerte, ya me dirás qué es.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tú también deberías llevar un
amuleto, flor. La suerte nunca
viene mal.
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}¡Si encuentras alguno que combine
con tu color de ojos, mejor que
mejor!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Crois-tu à la chance,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
Moi je n'y crois pas,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0010:}} je SAIS qu'elle
existe. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Et ce n'est pas tout.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Je sais que certains objets attirent
la chance. {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Moi, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}je ne me sépare
jamais de mon porte-bonheur.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Et il me porte tellement chance,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} que
grâce à lui j'ai la chance qu'il aille
bien avec toutes mes tenues.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Coïncidence ? {{TAG:0007:0000:2D000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Je ne crois pas.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je
serais toi,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} je m'en procurerais un
sans plus tarder.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Et si tu as de la chance, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}ce sera un
porte-bonheur d'une couleur
assortie à celle de tes yeux.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Credi alla fortuna, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
Io sì, assolutamente!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Sono sicura che certi oggetti
sono fortunati. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Ce n'è uno che
porto sempre con me.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}E poi si abbina alla perfezione
con ciò che indosso di solito.
{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Che.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} fortuna!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Insomma, se credi che la buona
sorte non ti stia assistendo a
dovere, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}ti consiglio un portafortuna.
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}Prendine uno che si intoni
con il colore dei tuoi occhi.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Ich weiß zwar nicht, ob du an das
Glück glaubst, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}aber ich bin von
seiner Existenz überzeugt!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich bin mir ganz sicher, dass es
so etwas wie {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Glücksitems {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}gibt.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Ich weiß es einfach!
Ich besitze selbst eines, das ich
immer mit mir herumtrage.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Such dir also ein {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Glücksitem{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, wenn
du meinst, dass du das Glück nicht
auf deiner Seite hast.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Am besten ein schönes, das zu
deiner Augenfarbe passt.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0002:}}Haha!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Şansa inanır mısın bilmiyorum,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ama ben kesinlikle
inanırım.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bazı eşyaların şanslı olduğunu
BİLİYORUM. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Benim de sürekli yanımda

{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Üstelik şanslı eşyam çoğu kombinimle

casi cualquier cosa del pueblo?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}If you want to grow a really vibrant
garden this year, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}I've got a little tip
for you.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Don't just mix up your plants
randomly. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Try placing some of the
same type near each other.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}That kind of arrangement leads to
all sorts of interesting offspring.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}For example, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}two red lilies will
sometimes produce a black lily! {{TAG:0003:001C:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}You
can thank me later.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}¿Quieres que {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} sea un
auténtico vergel? Pues deja que
te dé un consejo.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}No mezcles plantas porque sí. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
Prueba a juntar las que sean
del mismo tipo.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Si lo haces bien, quizá crezca algo
interesante.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Por ejemplo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}si juntas dos lirios
de color rojo, puede que obtengas
lirios negros. {{TAG:0003:001C:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}¿No es curioso?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}J'ai un petit conseil de jardinage à
te donner, si tu t'intéresses aux
fleurs...
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Le secret,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} pour obtenir de belles
couleurs,{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} c'est de bien combiner
celles que tu plantes.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Regroupe-les par variété, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}et tu
obtiendras des résultats parfois
surprenants.
Par exemple, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0010:}}deux lys rouges
peuvent donner naissance à un
lys noir !
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Comme tu le vois,{{TAG:0007:0000:20000000}} les plantes ont
plus de points communs avec nous
que l'on pourrait le penser...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Se vuoi stupire tutti
con le tue doti di giardinaggio,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}posso darti un bel consiglio.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Non mettere piante a casaccio!
{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Prova a tenere insieme
quelle dello stesso tipo.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Così facendo, otterrai
risultati inaspettati.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Per esempio, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}due gigli rossi
potrebbero dar vita a uno nero!
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Vedrai, mi ringrazierai un giorno.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Wenn du willst, dass {{TAG:0005:0006:}}
besonders hübsch wird, habe
ich einen Tipp für dich.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Überlass nichts dem Zufall!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Pflanze Blumen nicht wie
Kraut und Rüben!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Es ist wesentlich besser, Pflanzen
der gleichen Art nebeneinander zu
setzen.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Wenn sich die Blumen kreuzen,
bekommst du nämlich interessante
Mischungen.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Aus zwei roten Lilien entsteht so
gelegentlich eine schwarze Lilie,
habe ich beobachtet.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Kurios, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}nicht?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Bu yıl gerçekten canlı bir bahçe
yetiştirmek istiyorsan,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} sana küçük
bir önerim var.
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bitkilerini rastgele karıştırma. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Aynı

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}If you ever want to just get away
from {{TAG:0005:0005:}} for a little bit,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} you
should check out the island nearby.
Just talk to {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Kapp'n{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} about a ride
over there. {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}He'll help you out.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001D:}}Then when you get there, you can
go diving and fishing for all kinds of
cool sea creatures.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Of course you'll need a wet suit, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}but

{{TAG:0003:001C:}}Bring me back some shellfish the
next time you visit! {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Si alguna vez te apetece tomarte
unas vacaciones,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} te recomiendo que
vayas a la isla.

{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}y te llevará en un santiamén.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001D:}}En esas aguas hay criaturas marinas
muy exóticas que puedes atrapar

{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Necesitarás un traje de buceo,
claro, pero allí tienen un servicio
de alquiler muy eficiente.
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}¡Si te animas a ir, tráeme un poco
de marisco, anda, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Sais-tu que quand tu veux changer

trouve au large {{TAG:000E:000A:0600640065002000040064002700}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} ?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Pour cela il suffit de parler à
{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Amiral{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Il se fera un plaisir de t'y

{{TAG:0003:001D:}}Une fois là-bas, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}tu pourras te

sous-marine,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} par exemple.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Il te faudra bien sûr revêtir un
maillot, {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}mais tu pourras en
emprunter un sur place.
{{TAG:0003:001C:}}Et si jamais tu trouvais un trésor
englouti, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}pense à le partager avec
moi,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !

{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Se restare sempre {{TAG:000E:0010:}} {{TAG:0005:0005:}}
ti annoia,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} potresti fare un salto

{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Ovviamente ti servirà una muta,

{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Besuch doch die nahe gelegene Insel,

{{TAG:0005:0005:}} gönnen willst!

{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Taucheranzug{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}aber den findest du

{{TAG:0003:001C:}}Du darfst mir auch gerne deinen
Fang vorbeibringen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
